title.zh: 英国央行三年来首次加息
title.en: 英国央行三年来首次加息

current_state.zh: The Bank of England raised its policy rate by 25 basis points to 4.00%, its first increase since August 2023, in line with market expectations, with Governor Bailey signaling more hikes are likely unless the Iran war is resolved.
current_state.en: The Bank of England raised its policy rate by 25 basis points to 4.00%, its first increase since August 2023, in line with market expectations, with Governor Bailey signaling more hikes are likely unless the Iran war is resolved.
